name: dretech-ai
description: Claude Code agents from dretech-ai — each available as a plugin or a standalone skill.

plugins.name: portfolio-advisor
plugins.description: Blunt, US-focused portfolio analysis tool with local markdown memory and an account-number guard.

plugins.name: vacation-planner
plugins.description: Blunt, points-aware vacation planner with timeshare tracking, optional Perplexity search, and a portfolio affordability check.

plugins.name: home-improvement
plugins.description: Blunt home improvement planner: estimate comparison, need-vs-want backlog across properties, and a portfolio affordability check.

plugins.name: communications
plugins.description: Communications agent: turns what the other agents queue into Google Calendar events, Google Tasks, and Gmail drafts after you confirm. Never sends or deletes.

plugins.name: insurance-advisor
plugins.description: Blunt insurance advisor: coverage gaps and over-coverage, price and quote comparison, and when to shop, checked against your portfolio and home files.
